digest.component_or_area: differ / mutation compute and production snapshot reconciliation
propositions: The raw compute_mutations API correctly emits field_drift for mismatched local vs Jira state, serving as a positive control for API contract compliance
The production snapshot caller violates the compute_mutations contract by passing both prev_snapshot and curr_snapshot as remote Jira state rather than real local state
A4-1 filters differ-owned field_drift and unbound_local emissions at the production call site, preserving the raw differ positive control for future migration to real local state
The call-site filter must remain in place to prevent weakening the pure differ and to enable future migration without changes
Verification confirms the production filter suppresses zero outbound updates for key-set entries while allowing genuine inbound creates and invariant repairs to pass through
Convergence and idempotency tests confirm mutation_count remains zero and the instrumented production path records zero per-mutation operations
